title: reset_index fails with MultiIndex in columns
body:

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df = pd.DataFrame([(1,2,3), (4,5,6)], columns = ['a','b','c'])
df.groupby(['a']).agg({'b': [np.mean, np.sum]}).reset_index()
